channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] News Tonight - Top Headlines and Weather for August 26
item.description: Here are the top headlines from the day, from here in Tampa Bay and around the world. Tampa Bay 28 Meteorologist Jason Adams gives Florida's most accurate forecast to help you plan your evening.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Labor Day travel 2026: What to know before your holiday weekend getaway
item.description: Labor Day weekend is the unofficial end of summer, and plenty of Americans are planning to squeeze in one final getaway before fall arrives.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] NFL ends the Pro Bowl game, but players will still be honored as Pro Bowlers
item.description: The Pro Bowl is no more, the NFL announced Wednesday, ending an exhibition of the league's top players that was held in some form almost every year since 1951.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Nuclear watchdog chief warns Iran maintains ‘many capabilities’ as Iranian officials block inspections
item.description: As the U.S.-Iran conflict enters its sixth month, the leader of the United Nations’ global nuclear watchdog acknowledged on Wednesday that Iran maintains “many capabilities” in its nuclear program.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Judge grants Blake Lively $400,000 of $8M in legal fees she sought in film fight with Justin Baldoni
item.description: A federal judge ruled Blake Lively will receive just over $400,000 of the $8 million she sought in legal fees from Justin Baldoni. Both sides are claiming victory. What do you think of the ruling?

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Fallen Polk County Fire Rescue chaplain honored at celebration of life
item.description: A Polk County Fire Rescue chaplain killed in a crash last week was laid to rest Wednesday. The man who spent his life serving others is being remembered by the very people he was there to support.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Temple Terrace water overhaul could mean major rate increase
item.description: Temple Terrace is moving forward with plans to overhaul its aging water treatment system and remove PFAS, or per- and polyfluoroalkyl chemicals, from its water.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trattoria Napoli opens in Zephyrhills with help from city grant program
item.description: Trattoria Napoli is now open in Zephyrhills, backed by a $50,000 city grant. The owner brings 30+ years of culinary experience to 7th Street.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Meet Tampa's new acting police chief: Bret Owen on building trust, talent and what comes next
item.description: Acting Tampa Police Chief Bret Owen marked one of his first major milestones in the role Wednesday as 32 new officers were sworn in to the Tampa Police Department.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Marine leader says joint exercises are necessary after Trump scales back drills
item.description: Lt. Gen. Jay Bargeron, the Marine Corps' deputy commandant for plans, policies and operations, told Scripps News joint exercises with allies remain a critical part of U.S. military strategy.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 'There's a bat in my mouth’: Virginia doctor's bat nightmare goes viral
item.description: A Virginia gastroenterologist's unsettling experience has gone viral on Instagram and carries an important public health message about bats and rabies exposure.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Robert F. Kennedy Jr. responds to our questions about Florida proposal to remove 4 required vaccines
item.description: Health & Human Services (HHS) Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and U.S. Sen. Ashley Moody, R-Fla., were in Tampa on Wednesday to discuss a new federal initiative to help improve school meals and nutrition.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Testimony ends in Lindsay Clancy murder trial. Jury set to hear closing arguments Thursday
item.description: The prosecution's final rebuttal witness testified Wednesday that Lindsay Clancy knew right from wrong when she killed her children. Closing arguments begin Thursday. Read the latest.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bulls name starting QB, count down to season opener
item.description: First-year head coach Brian Hartline named Michael Van Buren, Jr. his starting quarterback, but HE says every player must keep earning their spot week to week.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 'I don't want to have this become a surveillance state': DeSantis seeks overview of license plate camera use
item.description: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis said he is seeking an overview of the use of license plate camera readers.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Dolly Parton remembered for performances in Tampa Bay: 'It was just magic'
item.description: As the world mourns the Dolly Parton, the country legend is being remembered by the team at Ruth Eckerd Hall where she performed multiple times.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Billy Adams trial: Tampa rapper accused of killing pregnant girlfriend stands trial
item.description: Opening statements began Wednesday morning in Hillsborough County for the trial of a Tampa rapper accused of killing his pregnant girlfriend and her unborn child.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Deputies: Woman shoplifted at St. Petersburg Target while kids sat in hot car
item.description: A Pinellas mother sits in jail charged with leaving two children in a hot car while deputies say she went into a Target and shoplifted.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Pinellas County Deputy Surprised With ‘KidsFirst Award’ for community service
item.description: A Pinellas deputy who has spent 10 years building bridges between law enforcement and residents received a surprise honor Wednesday for his dedicated service to local youth and families.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: county commission] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Manatee County bans Flock cameras at county-operated parks, facilities
item.description: Manatee County commissioners voted 5-0 to prevent Flock license plate reading cameras from going up at county parks, facilities and buildings.
